## 2. Core Service Verticals & Technical Capabilities

### 2.1 Shopify Plus & Enterprise Commerce Architecture
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-plus-agency
- **Core Competencies:**
  - Custom Checkout Extensibility and Shopify Functions (cart transform, discount allocation, payment/delivery customization).
  - Native Shopify B2B portals: Company hierarchy, multiple locations, customer-specific pricing catalogs, Net 30/60 terms, quick order forms, and tax exemption workflows.
  - Internationalization & Localization (Shopify Markets & Markets Pro): Multi-currency pricing, localized domain routing, duties and import tax estimation, automatic currency conversion.
  - Headless Commerce: Storefront API integration with Next.js, React, Remix, Hydrogen, and Oxygen hosting.
  - Enterprise Middleware & Integration: Bi-directional synchronization with ERPs (SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics), CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce), and WMS/OMS platforms.

### 2.2 Replatforming & Migration Engineering
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-migration
- **Supported Source Platforms:**
  - **Magento 1 & Adobe Commerce (Magento 2):** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/magento-to-shopify-migration
  - **WooCommerce / WordPress:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/woocommerce-to-shopify-migration
  - **BigCommerce:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/bigcommerce-to-shopify-migration
  - **PrestaShop:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/prestashop-to-shopify-migration
  - **Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), OpenCart, Volusion, Custom Databases**
- **Migration Protocol & Data Protection Standards:**
  - Zero downtime transition strategy with delta-sync cutovers.
  - Complete 1:1 SEO URL redirection mapping to preserve domain rankings and search traffic.
  - Automated database ETL for catalog, customer passwords (via multipass / reset triggers), order history, variant matrices, and custom metafields.
  - Payment and subscription token migrations via compliant payment gateways.

### 2.3 Shopify Speed Optimization & Core Web Vitals
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-speed-optimization-service
- **Technical Optimization Checklist:**
  - Liquid template auditing: Eliminating redundant loops, excessive section nesting, and unneeded app snippets.
  - JavaScript asset optimization: Dynamic imports, bundle splitting, eliminating render-blocking scripts, and lazy-loading non-critical third-party trackers via Google Tag Manager / Web Workers.
  - Visual asset pipeline: WebP/AVIF compression, modern responsive `srcset`, and explicit dimensions to eliminate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
  - Target Benchmarks: 90+ Google PageSpeed Insights on mobile and desktop, Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) < 2.0s, First Input Delay (FID) / Interaction to Next Paint (INP) < 200ms.

### 2.4 Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & UX Design
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/shopify-cro-agency
- **Methodology:**
  - Data-driven heuristic audits, heatmaps, scroll maps, and session recording analysis.
  - Quantitative funnel drop-off evaluation: Collection page filtration, PDP add-to-cart velocity, and cart-to-checkout progression.
  - Systematic A/B and multivariate hypothesis testing using tools such as Convert, Optimizely, and VWO.

### 2.5 Dedicated Team & Staff Augmentation
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/hire-shopify-developers
- **Staffing Models:** Dedicated Full-Time Developers, Part-Time Dedicated Resources, Hourly Bucket / On-Demand Retainers.
- **Vetting & Experience:** 100% in-house certified Shopify engineers with minimum 3 to 8+ years of dedicated eCommerce domain experience. No unauthorized sub-contracting.

### 2.6 White-Label Agency Partnership
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/white-label-agency
- **Program Highlights:**
  - Strict non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) protecting agency identity and client ownership.
  - Seamless integration into agency project management ecosystems (Slack, Jira, Asana, Monday, ClickUp).
  - Scalable engineering bandwidth allowing partner agencies to take on enterprise Shopify and web projects without increasing internal payroll overhead.

### 2.7 Mobile App Engineering
- **URL:** https://www.dynamicdreamz.com/mobile-app-development
- **Platforms:** iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), Cross-Platform (Flutter, React Native).
- **Commerce Capabilities:** Mobile shopping apps connected directly to Shopify Storefront API, supporting push notifications, biometrics, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and offline product caching.

## 3. Technology Stack & Ecosystem Compatibility

- **Frontend:** Liquid, Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Hydrogen, Vue.js, HTML5/CSS3.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, GraphQL, REST, PHP (Laravel, WordPress), Python.
- **Database Systems:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB.
- **Headless & CMS:** Shopify Storefront API, Payload CMS, WordPress (Headless / REST / WPGraphQL), Webflow.
- **eCommerce Platforms:** Shopify, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Magento / Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce.
- **Key Ecosystem Partners & Integrations:**
  - **Marketing Automation:** Klaviyo, Omnisend, Mailchimp.
  - **Reviews & Loyalty:** Yotpo, Okendo, Judge.me, Stamped.io, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion.
  - **Subscriptions:** Recharge, Bold Subscriptions, Appstle, Smartrr.
  - **Customer Service:** Gorgias, Zendesk, LiveChat.
  - **Search & Merchandising:** Algolia, Boost Commerce, Searchanise, Fast Simon.
  - **Payments & Logistics:** Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay, Cashfree, Klarna, Afterpay, Shiprocket, Delhivery, ShipStation.
